tools.name: browser_context
tools.description: Open or close a browser for this agent. Open with browser "fresh" for a throwaway browser that is never signed in, or "mine" for a private copy of the person's own Edge (or Chrome) profile so their sign-ins work. Both run in the background and never touch the person's open browser windows. Keep the returned contextId for browser_command, and close the browser when you are done; closing deletes its folder.

action.description: open starts a new browser and returns its contextId; close shuts it and deletes its folder.

browser.description: open only. fresh: empty, never signed in. mine: a copy of the person's own profile, deleted on close. Defaults to fresh.

contextId.description: close only. The contextId that open returned.

tools.name: browser_command
tools.description: Run one Playwright CLI page command in a browser that browser_context opened. args is argv, never shell text. Start with ["goto","https://example.com"] or ["snapshot"], then use the refs the snapshot shows, for example ["click","e4"] or ["fill","e4","text"]. Other commands include type, press, select, hover, check, go-back, reload, eval, screenshot, pdf, tab-list, tab-new, tab-select and tab-close. Opening, closing and choosing the browser happen only through browser_context.

contextId.description: The contextId that browser_context open returned.

args.description: The command and its arguments, for example ["snapshot"] or ["fill","e4","text"].
